_schema: injury_locks.json — per-zone injury locks (validator rule R002)
_usage: Each top-level key not starting with '_' is a body zone; every zone is evaluated. 'activation_keywords': case-insensitive substrings matched against athlete_static.md — if ANY matches, the lock is active (no keywords = never active). 'block_patterns': regex strings of exercise lines blocked while the lock is active; zone 'shoulder' falls back to a built-in list when absent, any other zone without block_patterns yields a WARNING ('not enforced'). 'allow_patterns': regex strings that exempt cleared exercises even when active (e.g. a physio-cleared passive Dead Hang); empty/absent = fully locked. Override this file in config/injury_locks.json with athlete-specific keywords, patterns and clearances.

shoulder.note: block_patterns omitted: the built-in shoulder list (pull-ups, hangs, rope climb, ...) applies. Add 'block_patterns' to replace it.

ankle.note: Example of a generic zone: keywords activate it, block_patterns list the blocked exercise classes.
